query: UPDATE assistant_actions a SET state='dispatching',proposal=NULL,dispatched_at=clock_timestamp() FROM assistant_batches b WHERE a.workspace_id=$1 AND a.user_id=$2 AND a.login_id=$3 AND a.id=$4 AND a.session_id=$5 AND a.operation_id=$6 AND a.request_hash=$7 AND a.state='batch_pending' AND a.expires_at>clock_timestamp() AND a.batch_id=$9 AND b.workspace_id=a.workspace_id AND b.user_id=a.user_id AND b.login_id=a.login_id AND b.session_id=a.session_id AND b.id=a.batch_id AND a.batch_index=b.next_index AND b.state='running' AND b.expires_at>clock_timestamp() AND b.run_expires_at>clock_timestamp() AND b.run_hash=$10 AND (NOT $8 OR (a.review_facts->>'version'='1' AND a.review_facts->>'operation_id'=$6 AND a.review_facts->'facts'->>'kind' IS NOT NULL AND (coalesce(a.review_facts->'facts'->'locked','null'::jsonb)<>'null'::jsonb OR coalesce(a.review_facts->'facts'->'priced','null'::jsonb)<>'null'::jsonb))) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM assistant_sessions s WHERE s.workspace_id=$1 AND s.id=$5 AND s.user_id=$2 AND s.login_id=$3 AND s.state='active' AND s.expires_at>clock_timestamp() AND s.last_seen_at>clock_timestamp()-interval '15 minutes') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM access_tokens t WHERE t.id=$3 AND t.user_id=$2 AND t.expires_at>clock_timestamp()) RETURNING a.review_facts AS "facts!"
